drg.description: Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 66-year-old female admitted for urinary tract infection. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.76, creatinine 0.91, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 274, sodium 140, wbc 6.8; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 73-79, map 90-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 120-127, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Urinalysis: positive nitrites, >50 WBC/hpf; Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 13.4, platelets 279, sodium 140, wbc 6.7; vitals dbp 74-79, heart_rate 73-79, map 89-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 119-126, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Urinary tract infection. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 66-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Urinary tract infection. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
